_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Tuesday — enterprise-pharma + governance day of W16. (1) Novo Nordisk × OpenAI enterprise-wide partnership — drug discovery + clinical trials + manufacturing + supply chains + commercial operations, full integration by end of 2026; largest pharma-side enterprise OpenAI deal disclosed to date; CEO Doustdar acknowledges deal will curb future hiring growth; sets up Thursday GPT-Rosalind launch with Novo as first-mover. (2) Anthropic Long-Term Benefit Trust appoints Novartis CEO Vas Narasimhan to Board of Directors — first major pharma executive on a frontier-lab board AND governance tipping point: LTBT-appointed directors now hold majority of board seats, mission-guardrail structure formally outvotes founder bloc; spawns new dedicated topic 'anthropic-governance-trust'. (3) Cloudflare ships Mesh + Agents Week Day-2 — service-mesh-equivalent for agents: zero-trust private networking, identity-bound connectivity between agents/MCP servers/enterprise APIs, edge-enforced policy; the security primitive enterprise agent deployments have been missing. (4) InnoEX 2026 opens in Hong Kong — 100+ robots including four of world's top-five humanoid makers (Unitree, Fourier, UBTECH, Booster Robotics); demos: boxing, musical performance, search-and-rescue choreography; densest single venue for Chinese humanoid robotics this year — spawns new topic 'embodied-ai-humanoids' under Models & capabilities. (5) Drew Breunig 'Cybersecurity Looks Like Proof of Work Now' formalises defensive answer to AISI Mythos finding — more tokens spent = more exploits found, open-source as asymmetric beneficiary; OpenAI Trusted Access (GPT-5.4-Cyber + Persona ID) emerges as vendor-managed analog of Glasswing. Research: CodeTracer (auditable coding-agent state); CocoaBench (wild-distribution unified-agent eval); Agentic Aggregation (parallel-scaling primitive for long-horizon agents); Credit Assignment in RL for LLMs; SWE-AGILE (dynamic context management vs MCP-tax); MEDS (memory-enhanced reward shaping vs RL diversity collapse); IceCache (long-sequence KV-cache eviction); Tracing-the-Roots (multi-agent data lineage reconstruction). Blogs: Gergely Orosz Pragmatic Engineer 900+ engineer survey — ~30% already hitting AI usage limits; Willison annotates OpenAI's Trusted Access counter-move; Cerebras vs NVIDIA wafer-scale read. STAGE MOVES: anthropic-governance-trust (new) → emerging; embodied-ai-humanoids (new) → emerging.

sectors.name: Methods & research
sectors.description: Depth Ceiling — LLMs execute latent reasoning at varying depths but consistently fail to discover the right multi-step planning strategies — discovery and execution dissociate. Direct evidence that CoT-monitoring captures execution but not strategy selection. MARS multi-token AR generation. SEVerA Formally Guarded Generative Models with first-order-logic specifications + Dafny verification.

sectors.name: Governance & market

New topic 'wall-street-mythos-briefings' spawns. Holland & Knight EU AI Act August deadline + IAPP machinery-rules amendments add the European regulatory side. Anthropic + Blackstone enterprise services thesis builds; CoreWeave $35B Meta backlog visible.
